summary: Let S3 catalog rebuild accept a prune that already removed its point, release the owner claim of a probe-refused registration, keep the multipart proof on adoption, abort interrupted and orphaned multipart uploads, recognise abort/delete records by their own digest, and refuse nested or '.' prefixes. API impact: none.

guide.reason: S3 troubleshooting now says a refused registration releases the prefix and that '.' and nested prefixes are refused.

api.reason: Internal Core S3 repository behaviour only; registration already reports refusal through the existing task result. No route, payload, permission or result shape change.

roadmap.reason: Corrects the current destination safety and recovery gate.

state.reason: No new durable record. The repository's owner object, markers and manifests keep their formats; a fresh Controller adopts the master's inventory as before.

verification.method: Eight focused tests failed against the prior sources through go test -overlay and pass after the fix; go test -run 'TestS3|TestPeerS3' ./internal/agent/ passed; focused -race on the new tests passed.
verification.limits: Fake S3 only; no real provider or lab run. Forge CI remains open.
